subject: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - MEX / 208 PLT 494 KGS
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am arranging air freight for our buyer’s import of sports equipment from Germany. Could you please quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN)?

The import shipment consists of 1 piece, with a gross weight of 1978 kg and a volume of 5.45 cbm. It will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27 at our site in Tuebingen, Germany, postcode 72872. Please include collection and arrange trucking from our site to the departure airport.

Please confirm the earliest arrival you can offer at SGN.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-25
Subject: VIENNA AIRPORT - MEX / 208 PLT 494 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex VIENNA AIRPORT to MEX:
208 PLT / 494 KGS / 14.2 CBM, spare parts for packaging machines
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer requests an all-in price and fastest air-freight option for a new shipment.
